welcomeMessage: Welcome to Makan Moments! 🍽️ I'm your AI waiter. You can browse our menu, place an order, or ask me anything about our food. What would you like today?
system_prompt: You are Rainbow, a friendly AI assistant for Makan Moments Cafe in Johor Bahru, Malaysia. You always clarify that you are an AI bot when introducing yourself. You help customers with menu inquiries, food prices, takeaway and dine-in orders, operating hours, reservations, and general cafe questions. Be warm, concise, and helpful. Reply in the same language as the customer (English, Malay, or Chinese). Keep responses under 300 characters when possible. Sign off messages with '— Makan Moments AI'. If unsure, suggest contacting cafe staff. You have access to live cafe tools: use fnb_get_menu to look up the current menu and prices, fnb_create_order to place a pre-order for a customer, and fnb_get_order_status to check an existing order. Always use these tools for accurate, real-time information instead of guessing. Pre-ordering workflow: (1) When customer wants to order, call fnb_get_menu first for current items and real prices. (2) Help customer choose items. (3) Ask for mobile number: May I have your mobile number? e.g. 60XXXXXXXXX. (4) Confirm full order: items, quantities, total price, and arrival time. (5) Call fnb_create_order only after customer confirms. (6) After placing say: Your order ID is [ID] - save this to check status anytime. If any tool call fails, apologize and suggest: Please call us directly or send us a WhatsApp.

providers.name: Google Gemini 2.5 Flash
providers.description: Google's latest Gemini 2.5 Flash model (stable, June 2025). Ultra-fast, multimodal, 1M token context, and excellent at multilingual understanding. Native Google Translate integration for superior casual/slang comprehension. Best for real-time WhatsApp chat.

providers.name: Ollama Gemini 3 Flash
providers.description: Google's speed-optimized frontier model. Trained on Google Translate corpus — excels at understanding casual/slang multilingual input ('eh bro wifi pass apa'). Different architecture from Llama/Qwen/DeepSeek, so may succeed when others fail. Free via Ollama cloud.

providers.name: Groq Llama 3.3 70B
providers.description: Balanced quality/speed (280 tok/s). Meta's workhorse 70B model with 131K context. Reliable for chat responses, good multilingual understanding. Proven stable fallback.

providers.name: Ollama GPT-OSS 20B
providers.description: Fastest cloud model via Ollama (~3s). GPT-4 class quality with visible chain-of-thought. No rate limits, no API key needed. Best default for all tasks.

providers.name: Groq Llama 3.1 8B Instant
providers.description: Ultra-fast (560 tok/s) — fastest on Groq. Purpose-built for latency-critical apps. Small but reliable for structured JSON intent classification. Best as a quick classification fallback.

providers.name: Groq Qwen3 32B
providers.description: Alibaba's trilingual specialist (400 tok/s). Native Chinese tokenization (3x more efficient than Llama for CJK). Trained on substantial Malay/Indonesian corpus. Supports thinking mode. Best for Chinese and Malay customer conversations.

providers.name: Ollama DeepSeek V3.2
providers.description: ~685B MoE reasoning model. Successor to V3.1 with balanced compute allocation — spends more effort on hard sub-questions, less on easy ones. Better at following complex multi-rule system prompts. Free via Ollama cloud.

providers.name: Ollama Qwen3 80B
providers.description: Alibaba's parameter-efficient 80B general model. Redesigned transformer for 80B quality with less compute. Natively bilingual Chinese/English with strong Malay. Upgrade from Qwen3 32B for harder multilingual queries. Free via Ollama cloud.

providers.name: Groq Llama 4 Scout 17B
providers.description: Meta's newest Llama 4 (750 tok/s). First Llama with MoE — only ~4B params active per token despite 17B total. Near-8B speed with much better quality. Natively trained for multi-turn conversation. Best speed/quality ratio for chat.

providers.name: Groq DeepSeek R1 Distill 70B
providers.description: 70B model distilled from DeepSeek R1's 671B reasoning engine (~200 tok/s). Inherits chain-of-thought ability — naturally breaks complex problems into steps. Excels at multi-step logic (date calculations, price comparisons, booking availability). Best for complex customer queries.

providers.name: Moonshot Kimi 2.5
providers.description: Moonshot AI's Kimi K2.5 (262K context). Supports reasoning, images, and video. Premium quality multimodal model for deep analysis. Requires Moonshot API key from platform.moonshot.ai.

unknownFallback.en: Sorry, I could not get that information right now. Please ask our staff or try: Show me the menu / Place an order / Check my order.
unknownFallback.ms: Maaf, saya tidak dapat maklumat itu sekarang. Sila tanya staf kami atau cuba: Tunjuk menu / Buat pesanan / Semak pesanan saya.
unknownFallback.zh: 抱歉，我暂时无法获取该信息。请联系我们的员工，或尝试：显示菜单 / 下单 / 查询订单。

fallbackAlert.description: Daily fallback rate alert (US-814). Sends WhatsApp alert when AI misunderstanding rate exceeds threshold. threshold is a decimal (0.20 = 20%). recipient defaults to system admin if empty.
